info.name: KaamGar API
info.description:
Authentication, role-based access and cooperative management.

Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Edit the Variables tab if your host, admin email or admin password differ.

exec: // A fresh id per run keeps the test emails unique

item.name: 1. Setup (Platform Admin)
item.description: Log in as the seeded Platform Admin and create a cooperative + a Cooperative Admin.

exec: pm.test('Has access token and role platform_admin', function () { pm.expect(d.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql('platform_admin'); });
pm.test('At least one cooperative', function () { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 2. Register
item.description: Public sign-up. Only customer and worker are allowed. The 'should fail' requests prove that.

exec: pm.test('Role is customer and active', function () { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('customer'); pm.expect(u.status).to.eql('active'); });

item.name: Register Worker (joins a cooperative, starts as pending)
Register Worker in the OTHER cooperative
SHOULD FAIL: worker without a cooperative
3. Login
item.description: Logs in each role and stores its token. Customer is last so the refresh cookie in the next folder belongs to the customer.

item.name: SHOULD FAIL: unknown email (same message as wrong password)

exec: pm.test('Message does not reveal whether the email exists', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'); });

item.name: SHOULD FAIL: NoSQL/JSON injection in email
4. Session (cookie-based refresh)
item.description: Postman keeps the httpOnly refresh cookie in its cookie jar for localhost. The jar holds ONE refresh cookie per host, so run these straight after 'Login: Customer'.

item.name: SHOULD FAIL: change password with wrong current password
SHOULD FAIL: old access token after logout-all
5. Role matrix (4 roles x 4 protected endpoints)
item.description: Every role calls every protected endpoint. Only the matching role may succeed. /probe/* exists only when NODE_ENV is not production.

exec: pm.test('Sees several roles', function () { const roles = new Set(pm.response.json().data.users.map(u => u.role)); pm.expect(roles.size).to.be.above(1); });

item.name: Coop Admin: list users (only own cooperative's workers)

exec: pm.test('Only workers of my cooperative', function () { const us = pm.response.json().data.users; pm.expect(us.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(us.every(u => u.role === 'worker' && u.cooperativeId === pm.collectionVariables.get('cooperativeId'))).to.eql(true); });
